system.description:
Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. When cast, the triggering attack rolls an additional d20, taking the lower result. For the duration, until the beginning of your next turn, hostile creatures have disadvantage on attacks against you.

An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight.
